result.justification: The study has a clear objective to compare the susceptibility of cotton rats and BALB/c mice to RSV infection, and the methodology is detailed, specifying the experimental design, sample size, and procedures.

objective_evidence.quote: This study was conducted to systematically compare the susceptibility of cotton rats and BALB/c mice to RSV infection in the respiratory system and CNS.

method_evidence.quote: For both BALB/c mice and cotton rats, 6 animals per group (RSV-infected/PBS control). The sample size (n = 6 per group) was determined based on preliminary experiments and validated by post hoc power analysis.
